title: Customer labels
prompt: Parcel labels list customers as last name, first name and city, like `Okafor, Ines (Leeds)`. Write `solve(customers)` so it returns `customer_id` and that `label`.
rules: `name` is a first name and a last name with one space between them. A hyphen is part of a name.
The label is `<last>, <first> (<city>)`, exactly like `Okafor, Ines (Leeds)`.
If the name or the city is missing, the whole label is missing.
Return only `customer_id` and `label`, in that order.
hints: `F.split("name", " ")` gives `[first, last]`; pick each with `[0]` and `[1]`.
Which of `concat` and `concat_ws` gives a missing result when a part is missing?
